_comment: The choice space this benchmark pins: which encoders exist, and how a document longer
than the window may be handled. Read by prepare.py (to download), benchmark.py (to
validate the agent's choice and render the prompt) and sandbox_runner.py (to execute),
so none of them can drift from the others.
params_m, dim and max_seq_len are each encoder's published values; max_seq_len comes from
its sentence_bert_config.json. query_prefix is applied to queries only, as the bge model
cards instruct for retrieval -- omitting it costs several points of recall and would make
Encoders span 22M to 335M parameters so cost spans roughly 100x, which is what makes the
agent's choice measurable rather than cosmetic.

strategies.truncate: encode the first max_seq_len tokens only; one vector per document
strategies.chunk_mean: overlapping windows, averaged into one vector per document
strategies.chunk_max: overlapping windows kept separately; a document scores on its best chunk
